# Arena Campsites

> Arena Campsites is the camping brand of Arena Hospitality Group, operating 7 campsites, 1 glamping site, and 5 mobile home / camping home villages in Istria, Croatia. Locations span Pula, Medulin, Pomer, Premantura, and Banjole on the southern Istrian peninsula. The portfolio covers camping lots, mobile homes, camping homes, and glamping accommodation, set in preserved Mediterranean natural surroundings by the Adriatic Sea. Direct booking platform with best price guarantee.

Last updated: March 2026
Maintainer: info@arenacampsites.com

Key facts:
- 8 campsites (including 1 dedicated glamping site, Arena One 99 Glamping) + 5 mobile home villages, all in southern Istria
- Locations: Pula, Medulin, Pomer, Premantura, Banjole
- Accommodation types: camping lots (tent/caravan/camper), mobile homes, camping homes, glamping tents
- Over 40 years of experience in Istrian camping
- Best price guarantee: if a lower public rate is found elsewhere, Arena will match it and discount a further 5%
- No hidden booking fees, no cancellation fees on standard rates
- Payment on arrival for standard bookings; advance payment required for some special offers
- Contact: info@arenacampsites.com
- Pets welcome (fees may apply — check individual campsite)
- Arena Stoja is the only campsite open year-round (winter camping available)

## Entity relationships

- Owned by: Arena Hospitality Group d.d.
- Part of: PPHE Hotel Group
- Sister brand: Arena Hotels & Resorts (https://www.arenahotels.com)
- Umbrella portfolio: Arena Collection (https://www.arenacollection.com)
- Glamping: Arena One 99 Glamping also bookable via arenaglamping.com

- Southern Istria, Croatia (Pula, Medulin, Premantura, Banjole, Pomer)

## Key questions & answers

Q: How many campsites does Arena Campsites operate?
A: 7 campsites plus 1 dedicated glamping site (Arena One 99 Glamping), all in southern Istria.

Q: What accommodation types are available?
A: Camping lots (for tents, caravans, and campers), mobile homes, camping homes, and glamping tents.

Q: Is there a best price guarantee?
A: Yes. Arena Campsites guarantees the lowest public online rate and offers a further 5% discount if a lower rate is found elsewhere.

Q: Are there booking fees?
A: No hidden booking fees. Standard bookings are paid on arrival; some special offers require advance payment.

Q: Are pets allowed?
A: Yes, pets are generally welcome. Fees and specific conditions vary by campsite — check the individual campsite page.

Q: Is any campsite open in winter?
A: Yes. Arena Stoja in Pula offers winter camping year-round.

Q: Is glamping available?
A: Yes. Arena One 99 Glamping (formerly Arena Pomer) is an exclusive glamping site near Pomer, Istria, with 9 types of accommodation units for 2–6 people, all steps from the sea. Also bookable via arenaglamping.com.

Q: What are check-in and check-out times?
A: Times vary by campsite. Please refer to the individual campsite page or contact the campsite directly.

## Campsites

### Camping

**Pula**
- [Arena Stoja Campsite](https://www.arenacampsites.com/en/campsites-istria/camping-arena-stoja): Stoja peninsula, rocky and pebbly beaches, family-friendly, open year-round including winter camping

**Medulin**
- [Arena Grand Kažela Campsite](https://www.arenacampsites.com/en/campsites-istria/camping-arena-kazela): Large campsite with 2km of beaches, spacious lots; dedicated site also at arenagrandkazela.com
- [Arena Medulin Campsite](https://www.arenacampsites.com/en/campsites-istria/camping-arena-medulin): Large family campsite, sea views, sandy Bijeca beach nearby, A2 kids & teens club

**Pomer**
- [Arena One 99 Glamping](https://www.arenacampsites.com/en/campsites-istria/camping-arena-pomer): Exclusive glamping site, 9 accommodation unit types for 2–6 people, steps from the sea; also bookable at arenaglamping.com

**Premantura**
- [Arena Stupice Campsite](https://www.arenacampsites.com/en/campsites-istria/camping-arena-stupice): Gateway to Cape Kamenjak nature reserve, windsurfing, water sports, secluded Mediterranean setting
- [Arena Runke Campsite](https://www.arenacampsites.com/en/campsites-istria/camping-arena-runke): Small and intimate, 4 hectares, views over Medulin Bay
- [Arena Tašalera Campsite](https://www.arenacampsites.com/en/campsites-istria/camping-arena-tasalera): 9 hectares of pine forest, rocky beaches, near Kamenjak Cape

**Banjole**
- [Arena Indije Campsite](https://www.arenacampsites.com/en/campsites-istria/camping-arena-indije): Banjole, southern Istria

### Mobile Homes & Camping Homes

**Pula**
- [Arena Stoja Camping Homes](https://www.arenacampsites.com/en/mobile-homes-istria/mobile-homes-arena-stoja): Camping homes on Stoja peninsula

**Medulin**
- [Arena Grand Kažela Camping Homes](https://www.arenacampsites.com/en/mobile-homes-istria/mobile-homes-arena-kazela): Camping homes at Grand Kažela
- [Arena Medulin Mobile Homes](https://www.arenacampsites.com/en/mobile-homes-istria/mobile-homes-arena-medulin): Mobile homes in Mediterranean pine forest, beachside

**Premantura**
- [Arena Stupice Camping Homes](https://www.arenacampsites.com/en/mobile-homes-istria/mobile-homes-arena-stupice): Camping homes near Cape Kamenjak
- [Arena Tašalera Mobile Homes](https://www.arenacampsites.com/en/mobile-homes-istria/mobile-homes-arena-tasalera): Mobile homes in pine forest setting

**Banjole**
- [Arena Indije Camping Homes](https://www.arenacampsites.com/en/mobile-homes-istria/mobile-homes-arena-indije): Camping homes in Banjole

## Destinations

- [Pula](https://www.arenacampsites.com/en/destination/pula): Mediterranean city at the southern tip of Istria — Roman heritage, beaches, Pula Arena amphitheatre
- [Medulin](https://www.arenacampsites.com/en/destination/medulin): Resort town ~10km south of Pula — family-friendly, indented coastline, sandy beaches, water sports

## Amenities & Activities (across campsites)

- Blue Flag beaches and direct sea access at multiple sites
- Water sports: windsurfing, diving, kayaking, pedal boats, jet skis (site-dependent)
- Sports facilities: tennis, football, mini golf, table tennis (site-dependent)
- Kids & teens animation (A2 club at Arena Medulin)
- Restaurants, bars, and supermarkets on-site or nearby
- Free WiFi across all campsites
